hypothesis: A history can support multiple candidate values for the same field. Search for early and late witnesses to the property and for an explicit update at the current request. At answer time, compare a genuine record to a counterfactual that swaps which speaker asserted each dated statement. If the recurrent matrices carry useful source attribution, steering away from the speaker-swapped matrices should improve answer facts beyond text controls in the same witness set.
retrieval: Rank adjacent pairs of dialogue turns across all available sessions by BM25. Fuse the first 40, the best item from each session, and lexical hits expanded with relation words from a query-only rewrite. Rank candidates with frozen Contriever. Compare six best fused segments and a six-session diverse set. Witness retrieval separately adds the earliest and latest distinct source sessions from the first 12 fused sessions and a segment from the current encounter. Retain six passages; present true dates and speakers.
controls: Unconstrained Qwen answers on standard, diversified and witness lists. Include a strong explicit conflict-resolution prompt on identical witness evidence. Also include an ordinary second-pass critique. At decode, use the same explicit prompt and swap only the speaker labels in an independently built negative cache. Compare whole-cache and recurrent-matrix-only contrasts against ordinary decoding. Both contrast arms read identical positive evidence; only the internal negative state differs. Keep the positive prefix and one shared generated history. Greedy decoding with a 0.75 logit contrast, first 8 tokens, base-model plausibility >= 0.05 of the maximum probability. Decode up to 80 tokens. Include a neutral test with identical original and control text, which must produce the original next token. Also include twelve diversified passages, both with the ordinary and explicit prompt.
evaluator: Blind AI editorial score with official category rules pinned from Tao et al. Dynamic and static allow 0, 0.5, 1; conditional allows 0 or 1. Report fully correct fraction and macro fractional score. A subsequent independent transfer should also have a separately blinded adjudication. Compare all controls; do not claim numerical comparability to the authors' different judge. No method labels, tokens, speed or explanations of system internals in scoring. One case per type per persona; bootstrap personas.
gate: On 24 pilot questions, require at least three additional fully correct responses and no lower average graded score than the strongest practical baseline. For recurrent attribution this includes matched whole-cache steering, and for any contrast it includes ordinary critique and the explicit evidence-only control. Otherwise discard. A transfer result requires at least five more fully correct answers on 48 new questions at 9B and a cluster-paired confidence interval excluding zero. No actions on held-out personas until eligible.
budget: One 4B development batch, 30 minutes per model phase and one repair. Local CPU/MLX with no paid resources. Record new generations, positions and runtime. The mixed pipelines are accuracy experiments. Do not convert them into independent latency estimates.
